full_name.text: Jonathan Braden, also known as Jon, JB, or Braden. Born July 26, 1979 in Saanichton on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada.

current_location.text: Currently lives in Sofia, Bulgaria where he explores cobblestone streets, enjoys morning espresso at local cafés, and takes weekend hikes on Vitosha Mountain.

personality.text: Adventurous, empathetic, and playful soul with a passion for history, culture, and authentic connection. Balances thoughtful conversation with spontaneous exploration.

olive.text: Olive was a Puerto Rican street dog who came to Maine around 2003, a year after George. She was the smartest animal Jonathan ever knew. She and George both died the same week in May 2015 and were buried together under a live oak tree next to a natural spring on a ranch in Texas.

bucky.text: Bucky was Jonathan's little black poodle during his childhood on the farm in Saanichton. Bucky was with him through French Creek Elementary School and the moves to Lantzville and Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island.

george.text: George was one of Jonathan's dogs in Maine, adopted around 2002 in Calais, Maine. He and Olive both died the same week in May 2015 and were buried together under a live oak tree next to a natural spring on a ranch in Texas.

austin_years.text: Moved to Austin, Texas in August 2008 and lived there until March 2018 for nearly 10 years. The music scene was amazing, the food was fantastic, and made lifelong friends. Hosted Electric Aquatic Club boat parties.

europe_journey.text: Moved to Europe in March 2018. Lived in Split Croatia, Prague, Valencia, Bucharest, Budapest, Montreal, Toronto, Panama, Costa Rica, Montenegro, Albania, and Bulgaria where he lives now. When he first arrived could say 3 things in French, now speaks French, Spanish, and is learning Bulgarian.

maine_period.text: Moved with his family to Maine on July 5, 1994 at age 14. Lived there until 2008. Fell in love with the first girl he kissed, Tia, and they got married and bought a house together. Had two dogs George and Olive during this time.

childhood.text: Grew up on a small farm in Saanichton on Vancouver Island, BC, 2 miles down a dirt road along a creek from Mount Arrowsmith. Had chickens, cows, pigs, horses, and a garden with mostly homegrown food. Attended French Creek Elementary through 2nd grade with his little black poodle Bucky.

lantzville_move.text: Moved to Lantzville on Vancouver Island on September 4, 1987. Life changed dramatically from farm to suburbs - suddenly had 16 TV stations, neighborhood kids, and eventually a Nintendo. It all felt very futuristic compared to farm life.

qualicum_move.text: Moved to Qualicum Beach to another farm on May 18, 1991. Was back amongst the community he grew up with. Got his first CD player for his 13th birthday and started listening to music a lot. First CDs were Lenny Kravitz 'Are you gonna go my way' and Ace Of Base 'The Sign'.

valencia_spain.text: Lived in Valencia, Spain. Beautiful Mediterranean city with amazing architecture, great food, and vibrant culture. Part of Jonathan's European adventures.

budapest_hungary.text: Lived in Budapest, Hungary. Stunning city with thermal baths, incredible architecture, and rich history. One of Jonathan's favorite European experiences.

prague_czech.text: Lived in Prague, Czech Republic. Magical city with medieval architecture, great beer culture, and fascinating history. Part of Jonathan's European journey.

croatia_coast.text: Lived on the coast of Croatia. Beautiful Adriatic coastline with crystal clear waters, stunning islands, and charming coastal towns. Amazing European experience.

verteillac_france.text: Has strong connections to Verteillac, France where his parents retired in 2017. Rural French village with gardens, projects, and two black poodles Gus and Una.

krissy.text: Krissy is Jonathan's partner, born April 1999. They started their relationship April 22, 2023 in Sofia. She's studying law, speaks Bulgarian, French, and English, and loves yoga, pilates, and healthy eating. She loves Romeo too.

tia.text: Tia was the first girl Jonathan kissed and fell in love with in Maine. They got married and bought a house together during his time in Maine from 1994 to 2008.

tyler.text: Tyler McCoy is one of Jonathan's closest friends from Austin. He's 46, tall, cool, hip, balanced, and smart. A yoga instructor and tech enthusiast who loves food and travel. Has a partner Cansu from Istanbul.

eric.text: Eric is one of Jonathan's best friends from New York City. Brilliant, creative, cultured, knowledgeable about art and history. An experienced actor and aspiring clown with positive and negative charge tattoos on his arms.

brother.text: Geoff is Jonathan's older brother. They grew up together on the farm in Saanichton with their parents Eric and Mary Braden, sharing a wonderful childhood with animals and homegrown food.

parents.text: Eric and Mary Braden are Jonathan's parents who raised him and his older brother Geoff on a small farm in Saanichton, Vancouver Island. They had chickens, cows, pigs, horses, and a garden where they grew most of their food. They gave Jonathan a wonderful childhood.

trump.text: Jonathan thinks Trump is a miserable mother fucker and rat bastard with little regard for anybody but himself. Left America because he couldn't handle Trump's America. Protested Trump and felt democracy died when he took office.

female_leadership.text: There needs to be more women in charge, plain and simple. Jonathan has no doubt the world would be a lot less chaotic and probably a lot more compassionate with more female leadership.

learning_journey.text: When Jonathan first arrived in Europe in 2018, he could only say 3 things in French. Now he has learned to speak French and Spanish fluently, and is currently working on learning Bulgarian. He once could speak a lot of Hungarian and Romanian as well.

music.text: Loves The Beatles, classical music, Nirvana, Philip Glass, delta blues, Velvet Underground, experimental electronic, The Voidz, and Orthodox chants. First cassette at age 7 was Beach Boys and Elvis. Chatted with Thom Yorke for 10 minutes last summer.

hobbies.text: Weekend hikes and picnics on Vitosha Mountain, curating historical artifacts, cooking international recipes, playing guitar for 30 years, stand-up comedy, abstract painting, exploring galleries with Krissy, training Romeo new tricks.
